description: Defines the SignupPage class for automating and testing the signup page UI in a Mattermost application using Playwright.

classes.name: SignupPage
classes.description: Represents the signup page with methods to interact with and verify UI elements.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SignupPage with locators for various UI elements.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Waits for the page to load and verifies key elements are visible.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates to the signup page URL.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Fills in user details, checks the terms checkbox, clicks create, and optionally waits for navigation.
